summary: Fixed the open QA-1 finding only: R8's 'band visible on the disabled colours of every button style' edge case now covers outline, text and dashed as well as solid. Added one test that proves each non-solid disabled style paints an opaque own colour (currentColor = --zest-color-disabled-text in both themes), that the programmatic ::before band uses that currentColor, that no rule zeroes or hides the band for those styles, and that a real disabled render still receives sheenProgrammatic while staying disabled. No production, style or documentation files changed; only the one test file. Full suite: 372 tests passing, coverage 98.75% statements (unchanged).
